Four Ways I Can Help You Win

360° Performance Media

End to end paid media planning, execution and optimization across every addressable channel, managed as one connected system and measured on incrementality, ROAS and cost per acquisition rather than impressions.

  • Paid search (SEM) and SEO working as one acquisition engine: keyword strategy, Shopping and Performance Max, technical and content SEO, AI search visibility
  • Paid social across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn and Snap: full funnel structures, first party audiences, lookalikes, creative testing and Advantage+ automation
  • Programmatic on DV360, The Trade Desk and Amazon DSP: PMP and programmatic guaranteed deals, brand safety, viewability and frequency governance
  • Connected TV and OTT: Samsung, LG, Roku, YouTube and broadcaster CTV with exposed versus control incrementality and brand lift measurement
  • Digital out of home and audio: programmatic DOOH, Spotify, DAX and podcast inventory bought and reported against reach and store visit lift
  • Retail media and commerce media: Criteo, Walmart Connect and onsite RMN inventory, from channel business case to peak season scale
  • Measurement operating system: marketing mix modelling, incrementality tests, MTA, weekly pacing and optimization cadences, executive dashboards
SEM & SEOPaid SocialProgrammaticCTV & OTTDOOHAudioRetail MediaMMM

Digital & Ecommerce Enablement

I sit between marketing, product, development and MarTech teams to turn a growth plan into shipped digital execution: the site, app, storefront and data foundation that paid media and organic demand convert through.

  • App launches and app growth programs: install campaigns, deep linking, Firebase and Adjust measurement, in app conversion and retention loops
  • Site redesigns and landing page systems built for conversion rate, page speed, SEO and tagging from the first wireframe
  • Storefront and shopping commerce builds on Shopify and enterprise platforms: product feeds, Google Merchant Center, Shopping and marketplace integrations
  • MarTech and data enablement: Adobe Experience Platform, Salesforce and Pardot, GA4 and Adobe Analytics, Looker Studio and Snowflake reporting, tag governance and consent
  • Ecommerce growth support end to end: subscription programs, digital flyer and CRM activation, email and lifecycle automation, promotional calendar execution
  • Requirements, prioritization and sprint level partnership with product and engineering so marketing dependencies ship on time
App GrowthSite & CROShopifyMarTechAdobe AEPSalesforceGA4

Account Management & Client Success

Years of agency account leadership across global brands means I know the pressure on both sides of the table: what clients are measured on, where relationships break, and how to turn a technical capability into a business result the client can defend upstairs.

  • Account operating model: QBR structure, joint success plans, escalation paths and the reporting cadence that keeps renewals safe
  • Solution led selling: mapping platform capabilities to the client's growth problem, then building the media plan, proposal and business case that wins the budget
  • RFP and pitch leadership: competitive narrative, pricing and deal structure (PG, PMP, managed service), objection handling and stakeholder mapping
  • Retention and expansion playbooks: adoption tracking, health scoring, upsell paths into new channels and products
  • Translating between client, agency, publisher and platform teams so technical solutions land as revenue outcomes, not features
QBRsSuccess PlansRFP & PitchRetentionExpansionDeal Structure

Demand Generation, Growth & Go to Market

Senior manager level ownership of the growth plan: from market entry and ideal customer profile through pipeline targets, channel investment and the operating rhythm that keeps a team accountable to revenue every week.

  • Go to market strategy: market sizing, competitive positioning, ICP and persona definition, launch sequencing and the first 90 days plan
  • B2B demand generation: account based marketing on RollWorks and LinkedIn, intent data, MQL to SQL pipeline design and Salesforce lead lifecycle integration
  • B2C growth programs: customer acquisition, activation and retention loops, loyalty and CRM activation, LTV and CAC economics
  • Budget planning and forecasting: annual and quarterly media plans, scenario models, contribution margin thinking and board ready growth narratives
  • Team operating rhythm: goal frameworks, weekly performance reviews, experimentation roadmaps and change management across marketing tooling

Founder Work

Two Brands, Built From Scratch

The same growth playbook I run for enterprise clients, applied to my own ventures: a candle brand built on product curation and a womenswear store built on Shopify. Both are mine end to end, from supplier and pricing decisions to the paid media that sells them.

M
Maisaah · Candles

A curated candle collection, scent by scent

$5K to $6Krevenue over one year of operation
$8 to $15price per candle, sold in the hundreds
Custom ordersweddings, birthdays, bachelorette & event gifting

Maisaah was my candle brand: I built and customized every candle from scratch and sold them as gifts through my own Shopify store. Priced between $8 and $15, they sold in the hundreds, with a handful of occasion orders for weddings, birthdays, bachelorette parties and other events. I ran the brand for a year and brought in roughly $5,000 to $6,000 in revenue over that time.

Travel & Content Creation

Visited 30 Countries & Counting

Thirty countries across six continents, and none of it was passive. I have eaten my way through night markets and family kitchens, sat in cathedrals and mosques and temples, walked cities where the history is still on the walls, and met people on every road who were nothing like me and somehow exactly like me.

Travel taught me the things school never did: how to be comfortable not knowing, how to read a room where I don't speak the language, how to listen first. It is why I am open, curious and at ease with people from anywhere, and it is why my multicultural campaign work at Walmart was sharper, because I have navigated that nuance in person, not from a brief.

I document every trip through photography, drone footage and short form video, and I am TICO certified through the Travel Industry Council of Ontario. A travel blog with the full archive is on its way.

The Person

A Little About Me

"I thrive at the intersection of data and storytelling, where the numbers reveal what creative alone cannot see."

I am a Toronto based growth marketing and ad tech consultant with more than a decade of experience building programs that deliver revenue. My career spans agency roles at Publicis Media and OMD Omnicom, managing global brands across DV360, The Trade Desk and Meta, enterprise roles at Walmart Canada and BMO's AIR MILES program, and in house leadership at Hudson's Bay and TELUS Digital.

That breadth is one of my biggest assets. I know what it looks like from the agency side, where you're managing a dozen clients simultaneously and need to deliver excellence on every one. And I know what it looks like from in house, where every dollar needs to justify itself to a CFO. That dual perspective makes me unusually effective at bridging strategy and execution.

Outside of work, I am a passionate traveller and photographer. I have documented 30 countries across six continents, with drone footage from Portugal and a pull toward the Mediterranean that keeps bringing me back. France is one of my favorite countries to shoot. Photography taught me to think carefully about composition, audience and emotional impact, and that same lens shapes how I approach creative strategy and content.

I have also competed in Young Lions, participated in datathons, coached marketing professionals through career transitions, founded a candle brand (Maisaah) and a womenswear store (Sorèla), and completed a Harvard Business School Online certificate in Business Strategy. I believe the best marketers are curious about the whole business, not just their channel.

Working on a growth, media or commerce problem?

I take on consulting engagements, fractional roles and full time leadership positions in Toronto and remote. Tell me what you are trying to grow and I will reply within two business days.
